literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe a single PANX3-HA construct. L2 is the most positionally informative: the construct was derived from the Origene plasmid PS100001 (Human PANX3 with a C-terminal Myc-DDK/FLAG tag) by replacing the FLAG tag with an HA tag, placing the HA tag at the intracellular C-terminus (after residue 392). The PANX3 C-terminus spans residues 289–392, which is entirely intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks. The immunolabelling results in L1, L3, and L4 (anti-HA antibody detecting predominantly punctate intracellular signal with some plasma-membrane signal) are fully consistent with an intracellular C-terminal tag: the protein traffics to the membrane, but the HA epitope faces the cytoplasm. No ledger line reports any tag insertion in ECL1 (60–108), ECL2 (233–267), or any other extracellular-facing position. The N-terminus (1–39) is also intracellular and carries no reported tag. Because the ledger provides zero evidence for an extracellular surface tag on PANX3, sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: HA tag appended at the C-terminus (replacing the FLAG tag of Origene PS100001); the PANX3 C-terminus (289–392) is entirely intracellular, so this tag is not accessible from the extracellular face.
